text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Now, allow us to explain the rules of the 
Mystery Treasure Hunt! 
Solve the riddles listed in the pamphlet 
and collect all 5 keys!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Once you gather the keys and reach the 
treasure chest, you'll win a present! 
Santa and the Reindeer are holding the 
hints to solve the riddles!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"The reindeer is Lady Mejiro Palmer, 
and Santa is myself, Mejiro Bright—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Along with all the other Mejiro 
Umamusume~. 
Ufufu, please feel free to catch whichever 
Santa you'd like~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"However, to receive a hint, you must 
first answer 
our 'Mejiro Family Quiz'!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"We've prepared questions of a slightly 
higher caliber~. Please feel free to 
exchange information and cooperate with 
your fellow participants to find the 
correct answers~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Work together and go get that treasure, 
everyone! 
And with that...—let the game begin!!"

text_block_list.name: Rocker Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Alright! Well then, reception girl! We're 
counting on ya!"

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan in Suit
text_block_list.text: "Hey, you!! Dober is—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...No... I'm fine. 
Um... thank you for your concern..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Question... 'What is Mejiro Ryan's best 
feature?' 
Please answer with the part Ryan herself 
considers it to be."

text_block_list.name: Rocker Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Best feature...? Ryan is the short-haired 
girl over there, right? 
Uhh... her muscles?"

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan in Dress
text_block_list.text:
"So close! Ryan-san's muscles are all 
magnificent, of course, but... 
I believe the answer is her hamstrings!"

text_block_list.name: Rocker Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Ohh, thank you! In that case, 
hamstrings!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Correct! ...You got lucky having her 
here. 
She truly is a dedicated, longtime fan of 
Ryan's."

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan in Dress
text_block_list.text:
"To think I'd get words of praise from 
Dober-san herself! What an honor~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Question! 'What is the origin of the 
brooch 
on Mejiro Ardan-san's racing attire?'"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Many Rings
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, no ideeeaa! 
Ah... hey, lady in the kimono! Do you know 
the answer to this?"

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
"Why, yes. It's modeled after a necklace 
given to her by Lady Ardan's father. 
She mentioned it on page 36 of the 
commemorative booklet from two years ago."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Correct! Nice teamwork!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Many Rings
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, we got it right! 
Dang, that knowledge is insane! You're 
like a professor! A Mejiro Professor!"

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
"Hohoho... you may ask me anything. 
I am what you would call a 'full-family 
stan,' after all."

text_block_list.name: Rocker Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, lady in the dress! Looking for Ryan? 
I think she's over by the roller coaster 
right now!"

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan in Suit
text_block_list.text:
"—Excuse me, if it's no trouble, 
could you help me find where Lady Mejiro 
Ramonu is...?"

text_block_list.name: Rocker Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Sure thing! Honestly, I was gonna head to 
Ramonu-sama next anyway. 
It'd be a huge help if we went together 
and you helped me with the quiz!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Longtime fans and first-time visitors 
alike are...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! They're all helping each other out! 
Aha... we did it, ahahaha! Everyone's 
having so much fun!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed~. 
What a relief... Everyone will be heading 
home with a smile on their face."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Every single participant has claimed 
their present~. 
How wonderful~. *clap clap clap*~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you all so much for coming today. 
Please have a safe trip home. 
And please continue to support the Mejiro 
family in the future!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(It all wrapped up without a hitch... 
Great job, Bright, Dober!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
They did so wonderfully... Oh, come on... 
why am I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sorry... whenever I think about how 
you didn't even need me... I just...)

text_block_list.name: Dober & Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Ryan! 
Ryan-onesama!"

text_block_list.name: Dober & Bright
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Dober! Bright!? 
Huh? Is this...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"It's a present! From Bright and me. 
...To show our gratitude for everything 
you've done for us."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for guiding us ever since we 
were young. 
This is our way of repaying that kindness. 
—Both the present and managing this 
event."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"We've always looked up to your back, 
Ryan. 
Remembering that, I did my best to push 
myself too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Making Christmas Night a success and 
showing our growth 
to you, Ryan-onesama—that was our goal all 
along."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"While... remembering me...? 
—...So that's how it was..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"We are who we are today thanks to you, 
Onee-sama. 
From the bottom of our hearts, thank you. 
And... we love you so, so very much~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I love you too..................... so 
much, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"~~~~~~!! Yeah...!  
Thank you for the best Christmas present 
ever!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"—Oh, Helios? Yeah, it's over. 
It was a massive success! Like, totally, 
insanely hype! Ahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And you know... there's something I 
realized. ...Will you hear me out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I... think I actually really loved the 
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I always felt like I stood out like a sore 
thumb, but... 
I realized that being uniquely 
"un-Mejiro-like" was okay after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—The fledglings have taken flight. 
...Heh. I'm looking forward to next year.
